pages.title: Tension Post
pages.text: Logs around a Binding Knot, Thread on top. Place it on the pad. Right-click it with a Strand token to **seat** that Strand. The notch lights, the tribe chimes, the pad changes.

pages.title: Knot, then seat
pages.text:
A **Strand token** is proof. You never craft one. You never spend one in a recipe.

Each Strand chapter in the assignment list ends in a **Knot** (hexagon). Tick it; the token drops. **Seat it** at the Post. Spares are souvenirs. Only the first seat counts.

Two of Clock, Swarm, or Spark seated, plus a Strand Filament on the Post: **Braid Cord**. All nine seated, plus a March stone: the **Spindle Loom Fragment**. Seat that too.
